critical_code_review_comments: conftest.py + _setup_temp_super.py provide a clean, reusable fixture pattern for future testing agents — no more hardcoded user credentials; TEST_SUPER_PHONE/TEST_SUPER_PASS env vars override defaults.

test_iter6 originally queried users by {role:'superadmin'} which is ambiguous when a temp super coexists with the user's real super — now queries by full_name='TEST Temp Superadmin' so behavior is deterministic regardless of phone changes during the test.

backend admin_routes.py:_primary_superadmin falls back to 'oldest superadmin by created_at' when SUPERADMIN_PHONE in .env doesn't match any user — since user changed their super's phone from 081200000001 to 08123456789, this fallback path is exercised in production; consider updating .env SUPERADMIN_PHONE to match or removing that env var to force the fallback explicitly.

status.js remains the single source of truth for status/action/entity labels; the 4 'Overdue' leaks fixed this iteration bypassed statusLabel() by hardcoding English strings in StatCards and one backend response — recommend a follow-up sweep to ensure all StatCard/pie/table labels use statusLabel(S_OVERDUE) or an equivalent shared constant.

rca of the issue: Iter13 blocker RCA: backend regression suite hardcoded SUPER_PHONE='081200000001'/'Sup3rAdmin!2026', but user renamed superadmin to 08123456789 with unknown password. Root cause: tests assumed a static, well-known superadmin. Mitigation: added session-scoped conftest.py that seeds its own bcrypt-hashed temp super with str(uuid.uuid4()) _id (critical — /api/auth/me looks up users by string UUID sub, so ObjectId-based _ids break auth as documented in iter13) and cleans it up on teardown. This fixture pattern is now the durable answer for any test that needs superadmin auth. Additional finding: 4 'Overdue' strings that iter12/13 missed (2 dashboard StatCards, 1 report StatCard, 1 backend pie label) — fixed in place.
